resources.string: Floatboat shows a small pill at the top of your screen when something happens, then gets out of the way. It needs a couple of permissions to do that.
Required. Floatboat uses this only to draw the pill on top of whatever app you are using. It does not read or capture what is on your screen.
Optional. Android shows a quiet status notification while the pill is running, with a button to stop it.
Optional. Lets the pill pop up for incoming calls and new notifications. Floatboat reads the app name, title and text only to show them in the pill. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Turn the pill on. It stays hidden and pops up for the torch, charging, calls and notifications. Tap it for details, swipe it up to dismiss.
Floatboat lines the pill up with your camera cutout automatically. Use these if it is not quite right on your phone.
Floatboat works entirely on your device. It has no internet permission.
Shown while the floating pill is running.
The pill will appear when something happens.
Turn it off from quick settings
